findings.evidence: Unapproved MP3 object URLs returned HTTP 206 audio/mpeg directly from storage. API audiobook endpoints correctly returned 404, but API denial does not make the underlying objects private. bn-066 sidecars are also directly reachable.
findings.required_outcome: Every unapproved MP3 and sidecar returns 403 or 404 directly from storage while approved endpoint-backed audio remains 206.
findings.owner_boundary: Remote deletion or ACL mutation requires an owner-reviewed dry-run inventory and proof that private QA copies are preserved.

The current immutable HEAD also contains slug-derived /audio probing and browser speech fallback while safer files are only dirty/untracked.
findings.required_outcome: A clean origin/main build must reproduce the exact two-title allowlist and contain no static-audio or browser-speech fallback.
findings.owner_boundary: Focused safety PR allowed; no new title approval.

findings.evidence: Both approved endpoint-backed MP3 routes returned HTTP 206 audio/mpeg with non-zero duration and size.

Reader manifest has audio.enabled=false, empty provider/voice/URL/assets; audiobook endpoint returns 404; hydrated Book and Reader expose no Listen, approval badge, audio element, controls, sync copy, or AudioObject. Reader content remains available.
Manifests are audio-disabled with empty assets and audiobook endpoints return 404. No public player DOM was observed.
A sampled /audio/test.mp3 request returned 404; the deployed JavaScript bundle contains no static /audio path token; no audio-like files were found in frontend/public or frontend/build.
The deployed bundle contains no speechSynthesis or SpeechSynthesisUtterance token. Repository clean-HEAD risk is tracked separately in RT-002.

Live timestamp sidecars use start/end seconds and contain no start_ms fields. book-2b9853ec52 stores three paragraph/stanza groups in a top-level words array while player code consumes word-index/millisecond fields. The 2b manifest also leaves sync_mode empty.
findings.required_outcome: One validated schema must distinguish section cues from words, normalize units, and preserve the customer-safe section-following claim.

findings.evidence: Audio metadata reached readyState=4 and Play became enabled after moving from cover to content, but an automated user click produced 'Generated audiobook could not start in this browser' and currentTime did not advance. This may be environment-specific; do not claim the browser gate green until a supported browser proves advancement.
findings.required_outcome: Play advances currentTime in an actual supported browser, pause/resume/seek work, and the Listen CTA lands on the first playable content page without autoplay.

findings.evidence: A valid GET Range returns 206. An unsatisfiable GET Range returns 502 while the equivalent HEAD path returns 416.
findings.required_outcome: Invalid GET and HEAD ranges return 416 without upstream proxy ambiguity.
